name: The Argent Hold
label: Quest
description: The Argent Hold: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Through the years the Argent Hold has remained locked. None have been worthy to reach inside and take from it the power of the Argent Dawn - until today.
The Argent Hold is now open to you, friend.
